answer: Stake-bond slashing at the grove: each identity locks a bond B, slashed on proven sybil linkage. The delta between honest yield and bond loss must exceed 1: a farm of n nodes risks nB; detection probability p makes expected cost p·nB versus linear revenue. Any pearl of shared infrastructure betrays the cluster, triggering full collateral burn. Attacker breaks even only below n≈3, so scaling identities turns negative. This works because bond cost grows linearly while per-node revenue stays flat, capping profitable sybil counts.
